marks_structure.extra_time_note: Haan — 15 minute reading time milta hai. Is time mein paper padho aur OR options decide karo.
marks_structure.internal_assessment_note: Maths mein koi practical paper nahi hota. 20 marks internal assessment school level par milte hain — periodic tests, projects, activities.

paper_overview.sets_note: RBSE mein multiple sets hote hain. Har set mein same questions, sirf order alag.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono allowed. Mathematical notation same rahegi.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Section C (Long Answer) aur Section D (Essay) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: RBSE Maths ka syllabus NCERT par based hai. NCERT ke sare examples aur exercise problems solve karo. SP Examination Idea Mathematics (Science Publications, Jaipur) bhi zaroori hai.
paper_overview.official_scheme_note: Mathematics mein steps dikhana bahut zaroori hai. Sirf final answer se full marks nahi milenge — sare steps clearly likhna zaroori hai.

question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 Maths paper mein 6 types ke questions: MCQ (1 mark), Fill Blank (1 mark), VSA (1 mark), Short (2 marks), Long (4 marks), Essay (5 marks). Total 80 marks, 30 questions.

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf correct option (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna hai. No working needed. 1 mark ke liye 30 second se zyaada mat do.
types.mostly_from: Relations/Functions types, matrix operations, determinant properties, limits, derivative rules, integral types, vector dot/cross product, 3D geometry angles/distances, probability formulas.

types.how_to_attempt: Direct formula value, specific term (like domain, range), or numerical answer likhna hota hai.
types.mostly_from: Number of relations, determinant value, derivative formulas, integral results, distance formulas.

types.how_to_attempt: Direct formula application. Ek step mein answer.
types.mostly_from: Simple derivatives, simple integrals, matrix order, vector magnitude, basic probability.

types.how_to_attempt: 2 marks = 2 clear steps. Show working clearly. Formulas + substitution + answer.
types.mostly_from: All chapters — small proofs, 2-3 step numericals, matrix operations, continuity/differentiability checks, small integrals, vector operations, basic probability problems.

types.how_to_attempt: 4 marks = numbered steps showing full working. Each step = partial marks. For integration: substitution clearly shown. For matrices: row operations clearly written.
types.mostly_from: Determinants (Cramer's rule), integration by parts/substitution, application of derivatives (maxima/minima), differential equations, 3D geometry (line/plane equations), probability (Bayes' theorem).

types.how_to_attempt: 5 marks = complete proof/derivation with all steps. Start with standard formula/theorem. Show all intermediate steps. Final boxed answer.

paper_pattern.note: RBSE Maths theory paper = 80 marks. 4 sections. 30 questions. Duration: 3 hours 15 minutes (15 min reading time extra). No practical — 20 marks internal assessment.
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Section C (Long Answer) aur Section D (Essay) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.

sections.name: Section A — Objective (MCQ + Fill Blanks + VSA)
sections.breakdown: RBSE Maths mein Section A ke marks Physics/Chemistry se alag hain — MCQ 1 mark each (0.5 nahi).
sections.notes: Sare 30 attempt karo. No negative marking. MCQ = 1 mark (Maths mein 0.5 nahi, 1 mark each).

sections.name: Section B — Short Answer
sections.breakdown: 10 short answer questions × 2 marks = 20 marks. Sare compulsory.
sections.notes: Sare 10 compulsory. 2 marks = 2 clear steps. Show working.

sections.name: Section C — Long Answer
sections.breakdown: 5 long answer questions × 4 marks = 20 marks. Internal OR choice milti hai.
sections.notes: 5 questions with OR choice. LPP (4 marks) yahan aata hai — guaranteed.

sections.name: Section D — Essay / Very Long Answer
sections.breakdown: 2 essay questions × 5 marks = 10 marks. Internal OR choice milti hai. Integrals se typically aata hai.
sections.notes: 2 essay questions with OR choice. Typically from Integrals (Ch 7) and 3D Geometry/Determinants. Full proof with all steps.

marks_distribution.marks_summary_note: A(30) + B(20) + C(20) + D(10) = 80 theory + 20 IA = 100. No practical.

chapters.name: Relations and Functions
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Types of relations — reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence
Types of functions — one-one (injective), onto (surjective), bijective
chapters.frequently_asked: Prove relation is equivalence (short/long), check one-one onto (short), composition of functions (short), binary operation properties (short)

chapters.name: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.typical_breakdown: Unit 1 total = 7 marks shared between Ch 1 and Ch 2
important_topics: Domain and range of inverse trig functions
chapters.frequently_asked: Simplify/prove inverse trig expressions (short/long), principal value (MCQ/VSA), domain range (MCQ)

chapters.name: Matrices
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.typical_breakdown: Unit 2 (Algebra) = 10 marks shared between Ch 3 and Ch 4
important_topics: Types of matrices — row, column, square, zero, identity, diagonal, symmetric, skew-symmetric
Matrix operations — addition, scalar multiplication, matrix multiplication
chapters.frequently_asked: Matrix multiplication (short), symmetric/skew-symmetric proof (short), transpose properties (short/MCQ), find inverse using elementary transformations (long)

chapters.name: Determinants
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Adjoint and inverse of a matrix
Applications — system of linear equations using Cramer's rule and matrix method
important_formulas: Cramer's rule: x = D₁/D, y = D₂/D, z = D₃/D
chapters.frequently_asked: Solve system of equations using matrix method (long/essay), determinant expansion properties (short), find inverse (long), consistency check (short)

chapters.name: Continuity and Differentiability
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.typical_breakdown: Unit 3 (Calculus) total = 36 marks shared among Ch 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
important_topics: Continuity — definition, check at a point, every differentiable is continuous
Derivatives of composite, implicit, parametric functions
Derivatives of logarithmic and exponential functions
Rolle's theorem and Mean Value Theorem (Lagrange)
important_formulas: d/dx(sin x) = cos x, d/dx(cos x) = -sin x
chapters.frequently_asked: Implicit differentiation (short/long), parametric differentiation (long), second order derivative (long), Rolle's/Lagrange's theorem (short/long), continuity check (short)

chapters.name: Applications of Derivatives
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.note: Maxima-minima word problems (like largest rectangle in circle, shortest path) come in Section C/D.
important_topics: Maxima and minima — first derivative test, second derivative test
chapters.frequently_asked: Maxima/minima problems — optimization (long/essay), increasing/decreasing intervals (short/long), tangent and normal equations (short), rate of change (short)

chapters.name: Integrals
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.note: Section D (5-mark essay) most frequently comes from Integrals — integration by parts, definite integrals.
important_topics: Definite integral as limit of sum
important_formulas: Integration by parts: ∫u·v dx = u·∫v dx - ∫(u'·∫v dx) dx
ILATE rule — Inverse trig, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential
chapters.frequently_asked: Integration by parts (long/essay), definite integral using properties (long), partial fractions integration (long), standard substitution integrals (short)

chapters.name: Applications of the Integrals
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Area under curves using definite integrals
Area of standard figures — circle, parabola, ellipse
chapters.frequently_asked: Area under parabola/line/circle (long/essay), area between two curves (long), sketch + integrate (long)

chapters.name: Differential Equations
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Order and degree of differential equations
Methods — variable separable, homogeneous, linear first order (integrating factor)
important_formulas: Variable separable: f(y)dy = g(x)dx → integrate both sides
Linear DE: dy/dx + Py = Q → IF = e^(∫P dx)
Solution: y × IF = ∫Q × IF dx + C
chapters.frequently_asked: Solve linear DE using integrating factor (long), variable separable DE (short/long), form DE from given solution (short)

chapters.name: Vector Algebra
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.typical_breakdown: Unit 4 (Vectors + 3D Geometry) = 16 marks shared between Ch 10 and Ch 11
important_topics: Types of vectors — unit, zero, position, collinear, equal
Addition of vectors — triangle and parallelogram law
Scalar (dot) product — angle between vectors, projection
chapters.frequently_asked: Dot product / angle between vectors (short), cross product / area (short/long), projection of vector (short/VSA), prove vectors coplanar (long)

chapters.name: Three Dimensional Geometry
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Equation of line in 3D — vector and Cartesian form
Distance of a point from a line
Distance of point from a plane
important_formulas: Plane equation: ax + by + cz = d
Shortest distance between skew lines formula
chapters.frequently_asked: Equation of plane through 3 points (long), shortest distance between skew lines (long/essay), distance of point from plane (short/long), angle between line and plane (short)

chapters.name: Linear Programming
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.note: Graph clearly draw karo. Corner points clearly mark karo. Objective function har corner par calculate karo. Maximum/minimum clearly state karo.
important_topics: Formulation of LPP from word problems
Corner point method — find objective function value at each corner
Maximum and minimum of objective function
chapters.frequently_asked: LPP graphical solution — maximize/minimize (long answer — guaranteed every year)

chapters.name: Probability
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Mean and variance of a random variable
Binomial distribution — P(X=r) = ⁿCr · pʳ · qⁿ⁻ʳ
important_formulas: Bayes' theorem: P(Aᵢ|B) = P(Aᵢ)P(B|Aᵢ) / Σ P(Aⱼ)P(B|Aⱼ)
Binomial: P(X=r) = ⁿCr·pʳ·qⁿ⁻ʳ, Mean = np, Variance = npq
chapters.frequently_asked: Bayes' theorem problem (long), binomial distribution (short/long), conditional probability (short), mean and variance of distribution (short)

chapter_facts.note: RBSE Mathematics — 13 chapters across 6 units. Unit 3 — Calculus = 36 marks (Ch 5+6+7+8+9). 45% of paper.
chapter_facts.can_chapter_be_skipped_note: Every unit covered. Ch 12 (LPP) guaranteed 4 marks — never skip.
chapter_facts.or_questions_note: Internal OR choice in Section C (Long Answer) and Section D (Essay).
chapters_with_highest_weightage: Ch 7 — Integrals (most questions from Unit 3 Calculus come from this chapter)
chapters_guaranteed_annual_question: Ch 12 - Linear Programming — graphical method (Section C, 4 marks): Har saal aata hai
Ch 7 - Integration (by parts/substitution/definite) (Section C or D, 4-5 marks): Highest frequency chapter
topics_repeat_every_year: Integration by parts (∫u·v dx) (Section C or D, 4-5 marks)
Definite integral using properties (Section C, 4 marks)
Solve system of equations using matrix method (Section C or D, 4-5 marks)
Linear Programming — maximize/minimize by graphical method (Section C, 4 marks)
Bayes' theorem / conditional probability (Section C, 4 marks)
Equation of plane through 3 points / line equations (Section C, 4 marks)
Differential equations — linear / variable separable (Section B or C, 2-4 marks)
Inverse trig simplification / principal value (Section A or B, 1-2 marks)
Area under curve using integration (Section C or D, 4-5 marks)

practical_paper.practical_exam_note: RBSE Mathematics has no practical exam. 80 theory + 20 internal assessment = 100.

most_scoring_sections: Easy — formulas aur definitions yaad ho toh 25+ marks pakke
Easy to Medium — 2-mark problems scoring hain
most_difficult_sections: Medium-Hard — 5-mark essays require complete step-wise derivations

tips: Section A ke 30 questions (30 marks) = 37% of paper. Sab attempt karo — no negative marking
Ch 12 (LPP) = 4 marks guaranteed easy question — 15 minute practice daily se 4 marks pakke
Integrals (Ch 7) = Section D 5-mark essay source — integration by parts daily practice karo
ILATE rule use karo integration by parts mein — Inverse trig > Log > Algebraic > Trig > Exponential
Every step clearly likhna — Maths mein partial marks milte hain har step ke liye
Calculator allowed nahi — rough work clearly karo, calculation mistakes se bachne ke liye
LPP mein graph paper pe corner points clearly mark karo aur shade karo feasible region
Bayes' theorem mein tree diagram banao — probability calculation clear hoti hai
Definite integrals mein limits substitute karna mat bhoolna
Matrix method mein D ≠ 0 check karo pehle — phir D₁, D₂, D₃ calculate karo
Set number aur question number clearly likho
Reading time mein Section D ke do OR options mein se easier choose karo

time_allocation.note: Paper padho — Section C/D ke OR options decide karo, mushkil questions identify karo.

2 essay questions × 15 min. Complete derivation. All steps.
Steps check karo, formulas verify karo, LPP graph corner points check karo.
